LandingFreeErp.h1: Free ERP: what you get on BabaBuilds without a subscription
introParagraphs: If you are evaluating a free ERP for a solo practice, micro-agency, or side business, you want more than a single-purpose invoice generator—you want a connected workspace for clients, quotes, billing, expenses, and compliance prep.

BabaBuilds ERP offers a permanent Free tier at ₹0 / $0 with access to the product modules described below. The Free plan uses generous but explicit quotas so the platform stays sustainable; upgrading to Pro or Team removes those caps and unlocks online payment collection through Razorpay and Stripe.
Create a workspace in minutes—no card required for the Free plan—or start a 15-day Pro trial when you need payment gateways immediately.

glance.title: Free plan at a glance
glance.intro: On the permanent Free tier (not in an active paid trial), the workspace keeps full navigation across core modules while these limits apply:

bullets.modules: Use the same operational modules as paid workspaces—clients, proposals, invoices, retainers, expenses, income views, tax dashboards, documents, reporting presets, cash-flow tooling, shop, workforce, payroll, imports, and more—subject to the quotas below.

bullets.seats: Up to {count} workspace seat(s); active members and pending invites both count toward the seat cap.

revenueParagraphs: The revenue stack is built for professional services: maintain a client record, draft proposals or quotes, convert wins into invoices, and automate recurring retainers when your plan supports payment-link injection.
On Free you can still model proposals, manage pipeline stages, and issue invoices—just remember the monthly invoice count and client caps so you do not hit guardrails mid-month.
moneyParagraphs: Expenses, income ledgers, and reporting presets help you understand performance without exporting everything to spreadsheets. Cash-flow surfaces and reconciliation-oriented workflows complement invoicing so leadership sees collections and burn in one place.
Use the help center articles linked below for step-by-step guidance on generating invoices, managing clients, and operating the reporting center.
complianceParagraphs: Tax dashboards, readiness cues, and document vault or inbox flows support month-end discipline. Availability of specific compliance packs varies by market; the product focuses on configurable tax defaults, traceable records, and structured storage rather than promising automatic filing outcomes.
Pair invoices with supporting documents so your team—or your accountant—has fewer last-minute scrambles.
optionalParagraphs: Beyond core finance, BabaBuilds exposes optional modules such as customer shopfronts, workforce attendance, payroll runs, import manager jobs, and AR collections. They are available to explore on Free within the same global limits; scale-heavy teams typically move to Pro or Team for headroom and automation tied to gateways.
teamParagraphs: The Free tier includes one workspace seat, which suits solo operators validating the product. Pro and Team tiers raise seat caps for growing teams while preserving role-based permissions for sensitive actions like billing management or tax approvals.

items.question: Is BabaBuilds ERP really free?
items.answer: Yes. The Free tier is a permanent ₹0 / $0 plan with access to the workspace modules described on this page. It includes explicit quotas for clients, monthly invoices, and shop listings so the service stays reliable for everyone.

items.question: What are the Free plan limits?
items.answer: On permanent Free you can maintain up to three active CRM clients, create up to five invoices per UTC calendar month, publish up to three shop services, and operate with a single workspace seat. Payment gateway links on invoices require Pro, Team, or an active Pro trial.

items.question: Can I collect payments online on the Free plan?
items.answer: Razorpay and Stripe payment links embedded in invoices and PDFs are available when your workspace has full paid features—meaning an active Pro trial or a Pro/Team subscription—not on the permanent Free tier.

items.question: What happens after the 15-day Pro trial ends?
items.answer: If you do not subscribe, the workspace returns to the Free tier quotas. Data you created remains accessible subject to those limits; upgrade anytime to restore unlimited invoices, higher seats, and gateway collection.

items.question: Who is the Free plan best for?
items.answer: Solo founders, boutique agencies validating workflows, and consultants who issue a handful of invoices each month benefit most. Teams that need multiple seats, unlimited invoices, or online collections should plan on Pro or Team.

items.question: Does free ERP mean every advanced module is unlimited?
items.answer: No. Free means you can explore the same modules as paid customers, but capacity-sensitive actions enforce the Free quotas. Heavy automation, payroll at scale, or large teams should move to paid tiers for headroom.

items.question: Is my data private on the Free tier?
items.answer: Yes. Free workspaces use the same application security model as paid workspaces, including role-based permissions for sensitive actions. You control invites, exports, and billing administrators.

items.question: How does BabaBuilds compare to spreadsheet ERP templates?
items.answer: Spreadsheets are flexible but fragile. BabaBuilds links clients, proposals, invoices, expenses, and documents in one auditable system with API-backed guardrails instead of manual cell maintenance.

items.question: Where can I learn implementation details?

BUSINESS_STATE_MISSING.fix: It decides CGST+SGST versus IGST. Choose it in Setup.

BUSINESS_TURNOVER_MISSING.title: Previous-year turnover is not set
BUSINESS_TURNOVER_MISSING.fix: It sets HSN digits and late-fee caps. Add it in Setup.

CLIENT_STATE_MISSING.title: {name} has no state ({count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}})
CLIENT_STATE_MISSING.fix: We assumed your own state. Set the customer's state so tax splits correctly.

CLIENT_GSTIN_INVALID.title: {name} has an invalid GSTIN ({count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}})
CLIENT_GSTIN_INVALID.fix: Invoices are treated as B2C until it is fixed. Correct the customer's tax ID.

CLIENT_STATE_MISMATCH.title: {name}: state differs from GSTIN ({count, plural, one {# invoice} other {# invoices}})
CLIENT_STATE_MISMATCH.fix: We used the GSTIN's state as place of supply. Update the customer record if that is wrong.

INVOICE_SAC_MISSING.title: {count, plural, one {# invoice has} other {# invoices have}} no SAC code ({name})
INVOICE_SAC_MISSING.fix: HSN/SAC is mandatory in GSTR-1 Table 12. Add it to the service.

INVOICE_TAX_MISMATCH.title: {count, plural, one {# invoice's} other {# invoices'}} line tax does not add up to its total ({name})
INVOICE_TAX_MISMATCH.fix: Returns use the invoice total. Check discounts and rounding.

EXPORT_WITH_TAX.title: {count, plural, one {# export invoice charges} other {# export invoices charge}} GST ({name})
EXPORT_WITH_TAX.fix: Reported as exports with payment of IGST. Use a LUT if you want zero tax.

EXPENSE_GSTIN_MISSING.title: {name}: bill has no supplier GSTIN
EXPENSE_GSTIN_MISSING.fix: Credit can't be claimed without it. Add the vendor's GSTIN on the expense.

EXPENSE_GSTIN_INVALID.title: {name}: supplier GSTIN is not valid
EXPENSE_GSTIN_INVALID.fix: Fix the GSTIN so it matches GSTR-2B.

EXPENSE_INVOICE_NO_MISSING.title: {name}: supplier invoice number missing
EXPENSE_INVOICE_NO_MISSING.fix: Needed to match the bill with GSTR-2B.

EXPENSE_TAX_EXCEEDS.title: {name}: GST is more than the bill amount
EXPENSE_TAX_EXCEEDS.fix: The amount should include GST. Check the figures.

EXPENSE_DUPLICATE.title: {name}: possible duplicate bill
EXPENSE_DUPLICATE.fix: Same supplier and invoice number was recorded twice. Remove one to avoid claiming credit twice.

EXPENSE_HSN_MISSING.title: {name}: bill has no HSN/SAC
EXPENSE_HSN_MISSING.fix: Used for the inward HSN summary in GSTR-9.

INVOICE_NUMBER_GAP.title: {count, plural, one {# invoice number is} other {# invoice numbers are}} missing from the series ({name})
INVOICE_NUMBER_GAP.fix: Every number must be issued or cancelled. Void unused numbers or note why they were skipped.

SEZ_NEEDS_GSTIN.title: SEZ supply needs the customer's GSTIN ({name})
SEZ_NEEDS_GSTIN.fix: Add a valid GSTIN to the customer, or clear the SEZ setting on the invoice.

EINVOICE_OVERDUE.title: {count, plural, one {# invoice is} other {# invoices are}} past the 30-day e-invoice window ({name})
EINVOICE_OVERDUE.fix: Report them to the invoice portal now: buyers cannot claim credit without an IRN.

EINVOICE_PENDING.title: {count, plural, one {# invoice needs} other {# invoices need}} an IRN ({name})

RULE37_SOON.title: {count, plural, one {# unpaid bill reaches} other {# unpaid bills reach}} 180 days soon ({name})
RULE37_SOON.fix: Pay the supplier before then, or the input credit must be reversed with interest.

ITC_HELD.title: {count, plural, one {# bill's credit is} other {# bills' credit is}} on hold ({name})
ITC_HELD.fix: Release it in GSTR-2B match once the supplier has filed.

ITC_CLAIM_DEADLINE.fix: Credit for last year's bills lapses after the deadline. Release or claim them now.
